stories.title: China, US, Russia issue 'peace declaration' after summit
stories.why_it_matters: It is a rare joint statement from the three powers' leaders, issued while both the Ukraine war and the Iran situation remain unresolved.

stories.title: UK, EU launch reset with deals on food, youth mobility
stories.why_it_matters: It marks a formal reset in UK-EU relations by altering the post-Brexit terms between the two sides.

stories.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
stories.why_it_matters: It is the first time the three leaders have held a trilateral discussion, which makes the meeting notable.

stories.title: O'Connor to 'vigorously' challenge sacking as HSE chief
stories.why_it_matters: A contested dismissal at the head of the health service points to a dispute over the leadership of a major public body.

stories.title: HSE board: CEO removed unanimously, not over single event
stories.why_it_matters: The statement gives the board's account of the decision at the top of the national health service, which has been publicly questioned.
